qaDiagnostics.overlapReviewCorrection: The initial assertion compared the entire flex container, including empty space. The corrected check measures the two actual attack glyphs against the roadblock guide. No game state or runtime rule was changed.

publicPerformanceDiagnostics.note: The first emulated-touch sample has low p10 FPS. Shared-host contention is not established as the sole cause; preserve the sample rather than claiming stable mobile 60 FPS.

transportDiagnostic: The local CONNECT proxy was unavailable for one preservation setup and one performance setup after cutover. Those failed before gameplay; the proxy was restored. A verification script initially requested docker top without a PID column and was corrected. No failed setup is counted as acceptance or a driving sample.

concurrentReleaseNote: A separate camera/audio release replaced the game and store with 10.0.1 during an initial public roadblock review, producing HTTP 502. Its native profile, eighteen source bindings, three binaries and roadblock/reverse modules were verified unchanged. The update was preserved and all public reviews were rerun using a snapshot of its 112 exact asset bytes. A subsequent SSH verification connection expired; it was replaced by a dedicated persistent connection. Interrupted attempts are not acceptance evidence.
